# V2V transmitter and receiver, vendored

An unmodified copy of `V2V_TXRXf.m` from https://github.com/avemath/v2v-bsm-ofdm at commit `3593f54`, with Windows line endings changed to Unix ones so the line numbers match. The home page V2V tile shows it in the Code tab and points each receiver stage at its lines. The live figure runs `src/lib/ofdm-rx.ts`, a browser port of the same receiver.
